name: Futā Nupu Hougōng
source:
As an inspiration to become a high-quality man, you are a young rich man with a harem of maids.
Dealing with your harem crisis is an important work. Some people need to be encouraged and some need to be punished.
As a master of supreme power, you can choose to forgive, or let everyone feel your anger.
Harshness is your tool to rule the harem; using cruel strategy is necessary to achieve your goals, but don't forget to show mercy when appropriate.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828970/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为一个成为高品质男人的灵感，你是一个拥有后宫女仆的年轻富翁。
处理你的后宫危机是一项重要的工作。有的人需要鼓励，有的人需要惩罚。
作为至高权力的主人，你可以选择原谅，也可以选择让所有人感受到你的愤怒。
严厉是你统治后宫的工具；使用残酷的策略是实现目标的必要条件，但不要忘记在适当的时候表现出怜悯。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1828970/]Steam[/url]]
